name: Akatsuki Kouichirou
source:
Art teacher of branch school. For Tsukasa, who is a newcomer, he is a senior and takes care of him. He has an intelligent appearance when standing silently, but he tends to give a strong  impression, such as making remarks that make others confused and his teeth glow when he smiles refreshingly.
